advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.comment: checkIfIsAvailable's date-override check never rejects a slot that starts before the override start (only one that ends before it), so slots partly outside the override hours are treated as available.

advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.comment: The override day is computed with local-time dayjs(date.start) while the slot day is formatted in UTC, so on a server not running in UTC overrides near midnight are applied to the wrong day or skipped.

advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.reason: slots.ts:105-131 uses dateOverrides.find(...) and returns false (unavailable) as soon as any single override on the slot's day has the slot outside its range. advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.comment: With several date-override ranges on the same day, a slot is rejected as soon as it falls outside any one of them, so slots inside the other ranges become unavailable.

advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.reason: slots.ts:579-586 does pass only busy and availabilityCheckProps (eventLength, currentSeats), so dateOverrides/workingHours default to []. advanced-date-override-handling-and-time.comment: Claims the selected-slots availability call site passes only the user's timezone, so dateOverrides and workingHours fall back to [] and slots are checked only against busy times.
